newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on heavy fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on heavy fund selling.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower Monday in repsonse to pressure from heavy commodity fund selling, pit traders said.
"We had a technical wash-out," a trader said.
Dean Witter sold 120 lots March, LIT sold 60 March and Refco sold 50 March, pit sources said.
LIT and Term Commodities, firms with commercial clients, were said to be scale-down buyers throughout the session, sources said.
Despite the losses, the fundamental aspects of the market remain quite sound, traders said.
"If it hadn't been for the fund selling, we wouldn't have been down at all today (Monday)," said a pit trader.
Supplies of rice remain tight, and rising milled rice prices in the U.S. were expected to support the market, traders said.
Traders also said Colombia's decision to pass on a tender for 50,000 tonnes of rice weighed on the market early.
Volume was estimated at 650 contracts, down from the 698 traded Friday. Rice futures closed 11 to 16 cents per cwt lower, with March down 11 at $11.58 and May down 16 at 11.57.
